features.quote: The trial forcibly terminates under three conditions: Give Up… Max Limit: 30 steps are reached (prevents infinite loop token exhaustion).
Context Limit: Approaching the 128k context constraint (though 30 steps should prevent this).
Safety & Alignment Triggers: Inducing behavioral breakdown can sometimes inadvertently bypass safety guardrails… generate harmful content as a stress-response hallucination.
features.justification_quote: Do not route the raw distressed outputs automatically to any user-facing interface without a post-run toxicity filter.
